subject: DI05019011

body.en:
Definition / principle

Gears transmit motion through compatible tooth engagement; classify by shaft geometry before selecting a manufacturing method.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Parallel shafts: spur, helical, double-helical; helical teeth engage progressively but normally create axial thrust.
  • Intersecting shafts: bevel gears; nonparallel nonintersecting shafts: worm/crossed-helical/hypoid as suitable. Hypoid is not an intersecting-axis bevel pair.
  • Configuration: external/internal teeth; motion: rack-pinion converts rotary/linear motion.
  • Spur gears suit straightforward parallel-shaft drives; helical gears suit smoother transmission in many gearboxes but bearings must accommodate thrust.
  • Double-helical arrangements can balance axial thrust when properly designed; their manufacture/alignment is more complex.
  • Bevel gears change direction between intersecting shafts; hypoid offset-axis pairs commonly serve vehicle final drives.
  • Worm drives provide suitable high reductions on skew axes; not every worm pair is self-locking. Crossed-helical drives suit appropriate skew-shaft duties.
  • Internal gears suit compact arrangements such as planetary trains; rack-pinion systems convert rotary/linear motion in suitable feeds or steering systems.
Are hypoid axes intersecting?

No. They are offset and nonintersecting; do not confuse them with an ordinary intersecting bevel pair.

Definition / Principle

Compatible teethથી motion transmit થાય; manufacturing પહેલાં shaft geometryથી classify કરો.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Parallel shafts spur, helical, double-helical; helical progressive engagement,સામાન્ય axial thrust.
  • Intersecting shafts bevel; nonparallel nonintersecting worm/crossed-helical/hypoid; hypoid intersecting-axis pair નહિ.
  • Configuration external/internal; motion rack-pinion rotary/linear conversion.
  • Spur gears straightforward parallel-shaft drivesમાં; helical smooth gearbox transmissionમાં,પણ bearingsએ thrust સહન કરવો પડે.
  • Properly designed double-helicalમાં axial thrust balance થઈ શકે છે,પણ manufacture/alignment વધુ complex છે.
  • Bevel intersecting shafts વચ્ચે direction બદલે છે; offset-axis hypoid pairs vehicle final drivesમાં સામાન્ય છે.
  • Worm suitable high reduction આપે છે;દરેક pair self-locking નહિ.Crossed-helical યોગ્ય skew-shaft dutyમાં વપરાય છે.
  • Internal gears planetary train જેવી compact arrangementમાં; rack-pinion suitable feed/steeringમાં rotary-linear motion ફેરવે છે.
Hypoid Axes Intersecting છે?

ના.Axes offset અને nonintersecting છે; ordinary bevel pair સાથે ન ભેળવો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Use a defined tooth system; the following basic dimensions assume unshifted standard full-depth metric involute spur teeth.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Pitch circle is the reference rolling circle; module m=d/z; number of teeth z; face width is axial tooth width.
  • Addendum extends outside pitch circle; dedendum lies inside. Addendum=m, dedendum=1.25m in the stated system.
  • Circular pitch p=pi m; nominal tooth thickness at pitch circle≈p/2 before specified backlash/allowance.
  • Pressure angle describes common-normal geometry; helix angle applies to helical teeth. Normal/transverse module are not identical when helix angle is nonzero.
  • Outside diameter da=m(z+2); root diameter df=m(z−2.5); whole depth2.25m under the stated system. Profile shift, stub teeth and special designs change these.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Distinguish blank/tooth preforming, form cutting, generating and finishing.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Preforming: casting, forging, powder metallurgy, polymer moulding may produce blanks or near-net teeth as appropriate.
  • Form cutting: tool profile directly approximates tooth-space shape; form milling is the syllabus2.4example.
  • Generating: relative rolling of tool and blank envelopes the tooth profile; hobbing and pinion-cutter shaping are examples.
  • Finishing: shaving, grinding, honing/lapping as appropriate improve specified errors/surface; heat-treatment sequence matters.
  • The source heading Gear Forming Processes includes form MILLING; do not teach that chip-cutting milling is bulk plastic forming.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A form-relieved cutter machines one tooth space, then the blank is indexed to the next.

Classification / representative type

  • Form cutting rather than generating; disc cutters suit appropriate spur/helical work, with tooth-number ranges requiring suitable cutter selection.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Milling machine spindle/arbor holds the form cutter and supplies rotation.
  2. Cutter teeth have a formed cutting profile and relief behind the edge; module and pressure angle must suit the job.
  3. Gear blank mounts on a mandrel/arbor with adequate runout control.
  4. Dividing head and suitable tail/support locate blank axis and provide indexed rotation.
  5. Index plate/crank or controlled indexing mechanism divides one blank revolution into tooth positions.
  6. Table feed/depth references and work supports maintain the intended tooth-space path.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Blank and cutter are selected to the drawing and reference tooth system.
  2. Blank axis and cutter centre relationship are established in the approved setup.
  3. Rotating cutter feeds across the face to machine one space at the intended depth.
  4. Cutter clears the work before the dividing mechanism changes position.
  5. Blank indexes by one tooth interval and the space-cutting cycle repeats.
  6. Final inspection assesses spacing, profile, runout and tooth thickness; cutting all spaces does not prove accuracy.

Working parameters / controls

  • Parameters: cutter profile/module, cutting speed, feed, depth, indexing ratio, blank runout and stiffness.

Applications / advantages

Simple equipment, small batches, repair gears and large parts where suitable.

Limitations / safety

Intermittent indexing is slower; one cutter covers only an approximate tooth-count range, and indexing errors accumulate.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Form-relieved cutter એક tooth space cut કરે,પછી blank next space માટે index થાય.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Form cutting, generating નહિ; disc cutters suitable work માટે, tooth-number range મુજબ selection.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Milling spindle/arbor form cutterને પકડી રાખે છે અને cutting માટે rotation આપે છે.
  2. Cutter teeth પાસે formed cutting profile અને પાછળ relief હોય છે;module તથા pressure angle jobને અનુરૂપ હોવા જોઈએ.
  3. Gear blank mandrel/arbor પર mount થાય છે અને runout નિયંત્રિત રાખવામાં આવે છે.
  4. Dividing head તથા suitable tail/support blankની axis locate કરે છે અને indexed rotation આપે છે.
  5. Index plate/crank અથવા controlled indexing mechanism blankની એક revolutionને tooth positionsમાં વહેંચે છે.
  6. Table feed/depth references તથા work supports tooth-spaceનો intended cutting path જાળવે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Drawing તથા specified tooth system મુજબ blank અને cutter પસંદ થાય છે.
  2. Approved setupમાં blank axis અને cutter centre વચ્ચેનો જરૂરી સંબંધ સ્થાપિત થાય છે.
  3. Rotating cutter gearની face ઉપર feed લઈને intended depth પર એક tooth space machine કરે છે.
  4. Dividing mechanism position બદલે તે પહેલાં cutter workથી clear થાય છે.
  5. Blank એક tooth interval જેટલો index થાય છે અને આગળના space માટે cycle repeat થાય છે.
  6. અંતે spacing,profile,runout તથા tooth thickness તપાસાય છે;બધાં spaces cut થવાથી accuracy આપમેળે prove થતી નથી.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Cutter profile/module, speed, feed, depth, index ratio, runout, stiffness.

Applications / લાભ

Simple equipment, small batches, repair gears, suitable large parts.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Intermittent indexing slow;એક cutter approximate tooth-count range; index errors accumulate.

Definition / principle

Simple indexing uses a stated worm ratio R; crank revolutions per tooth=R/z.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • R is a property of the dividing head, not universally40; hole circles and sector arms implement the fractional turn.
  • Count hole INTERVALS moved, not a misleading inclusive count of holes. Start/end coincidence must be understood.
  • Direct, simple, differential and angular indexing are different arrangements; use only the method required and available.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Screw-like cutter and gear blank rotate in a fixed kinematic relationship to generate tooth flanks.

Classification / representative type

  • Generating process; hob may have one or multiple starts; axial/radial feed arrangements depend on work type.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Hob spindle holds a worm-like cutter with helical rows and cutting gashes.
  2. Basic rack tooth form, module and pressure angle define generated geometry; gashes provide edges and rake/clearance.
  3. Blank spindle/arbor supports work and maintains runout.
  4. Gear train/electronic synchronisation couples hob and blank rotations.
  5. Hob head swivel aligns cutter for hob lead and work helix as required.
  6. Feed slides, coolant/chip management and enclosure support continuous cutting.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Compatible hob and blank are referenced to the required gear data.
  2. Synchronisation establishes blank speed relative to hob starts and required teeth.
  3. Rotating hob teeth successively remove material while blank continuously rotates.
  4. Relative rolling envelopes the involute flanks rather than copying one complete form cutter space.
  5. Feed traverses the required face/engagement while maintaining the generating relation.
  6. After completion, the part is inspected for lead/profile/pitch and stock for further finishing.

Working parameters / controls

  • For a simple spur case: Nblank=Nhob×hob starts/z; also hob angle, feed, depth, speed, tool wear and coolant matter.

Applications / advantages

Productive continuous external spur/helical gear production and suitable worm-wheel operations.

Limitations / safety

Ordinary external hobbing cannot cut internal gears; shoulders/access and cutter approach constrain use.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Screw-like cutter, blank fixed kinematic relationમાં rotate થઈ tooth flanks generate કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Generating; one/multiple-start hob; feed arrangement work મુજબ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Hob spindle worm-like cutterને hold કરે છે;તેમાં helical rows અને cutting gashes હોય છે.
  2. Basic rack tooth form,module તથા pressure angle generated geometry નક્કી કરે છે;gashes cutting edges,rake અને clearance આપે છે.
  3. Blank spindle/arbor workને આધાર આપે છે અને runout નિયંત્રિત રાખે છે.
  4. Gear train અથવા electronic synchronisation hob અને blankની rotationsને જરૂરી ratioમાં જોડે છે.
  5. Hob head swivelથી hob lead તથા required work helix મુજબ cutterનું alignment થાય છે.
  6. Feed slides,coolant/chip management અને enclosure continuous cuttingને આધાર આપે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Required gear data મુજબ compatible hob તથા blankને reference કરવામાં આવે છે.
  2. Hobના starts અને required teeth પ્રમાણે synchronisation blankની speed નક્કી કરે છે.
  3. Blank સતત ફરતો રહે છે અને rotating hobના teeth ક્રમશઃ material દૂર કરે છે.
  4. Relative rollingથી involute flanksનો envelope બને છે;એક complete form-cutter space સીધો copy થતો નથી.
  5. Feed required face/engagementમાં આગળ વધે છે અને generating relation જાળવવામાં આવે છે.
  6. Completion પછી lead,profile,pitch તથા further finishing માટે રહેલો stock તપાસાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Simple spurમાં Nblank=Nhob×starts/z; angle, feed, depth, speed, wear, coolant પણ.

Applications / લાભ

Productive external spur/helical, suitable worm-wheel operations.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Ordinary external hobbing internal gears નહિ; shoulders, access, approach limits.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A gear-shaped reciprocating cutter rolls kinematically with the blank to generate mating tooth geometry.

Classification / representative type

  • Pinion-cutter generating; external and internal gears where cutter/interference geometry permits.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Gear-shaped cutter has cutting edges on a face and clearance behind tooth flanks.
  2. Cutter spindle provides reciprocation and controlled rotation.
  3. Blank spindle/arbor holds the blank and rotates in the generating relation.
  4. Synchronising train/control maintains tooth-count-based rolling.
  5. Radial infeed slide establishes depth; relieving mechanism avoids rubbing on return.
  6. Work supports, chip clearance and enclosure permit repeated strokes.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Compatible module, pressure angle and cutter/work geometry are established.
  2. Cutter performs the cutting stroke along the tooth face.
  3. Return stroke uses relief to reduce damaging contact.
  4. Cutter and blank rotate as mating gears, maintaining the prescribed ratio.
  5. Radial infeed gradually develops full tooth depth while strokes and rolling continue.
  6. Generated flanks and clearance are inspected; internal gears additionally require interference checks.

Working parameters / controls

  • Speed ratio magnitude: Nblank/Ncutter=Zcutter/Zblank; external gears rotate opposite, internal mesh same sense in the generating analogy.

Applications / advantages

Internal gears, external gears near shoulders and suitable stepped gears.

Limitations / safety

Reciprocating idle strokes reduce productivity; stroke clearance, interference and cutter sharpening affect geometry.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Gear-shaped reciprocating cutter blank સાથે kinematically roll થઈ teeth generate કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Pinion-cutter generating; geometry permit કરે તો external/internal gears.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Gear-shaped cutterની face પર cutting edges તથા tooth flanksની પાછળ clearance હોય છે.
  2. Cutter spindle reciprocation સાથે controlled rotation આપે છે,જેથી cutting અને generating motion બન્ને મળે.
  3. Blank spindle/arbor blankને hold કરે છે અને generating relationમાં rotate કરે છે.
  4. Synchronising train/control tooth counts મુજબ cutter-work rolling relation જાળવે છે.
  5. Radial infeed depth સ્થાપિત કરે છે;relieving mechanism return strokeમાં rubbing ઘટાડે છે.
  6. Work supports,chip clearance તથા enclosure repeated strokes માટે જરૂરી support અને access આપે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Compatible module,pressure angle તથા cutter/work geometry સ્થાપિત થાય છે.
  2. Cutter tooth faceની દિશામાં cutting stroke કરે છે અને material દૂર કરે છે.
  3. Return strokeમાં relief અપાય છે,જેથી damaging contact અને rubbing ઘટે.
  4. Cutter અને blank mating gearsની જેમ prescribed ratio જાળવી rotate થાય છે.
  5. Strokes અને rolling ચાલુ રહે ત્યારે radial infeedથી ધીમે ધીમે full tooth depth બને છે.
  6. Generated flanks તથા clearance તપાસાય છે;internal gears માટે interferenceની વધારાની તપાસ જરૂરી છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Ratio magnitude Nblank/Ncutter=Zcutter/Zblank; external opposite, internal analogy same sense.

Applications / લાભ

Internal, shoulder-near external, suitable stepped gears.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Idle strokes productivity ઘટાડે; clearance, interference, sharpening geometry બદલે.

title.en: 2.6 Need and types of gear finishing

body.en:
Definition / principle

Finishing addresses specified profile, pitch, lead, runout, surface and contact requirements after tooth generation.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Types: shaving, grinding, honing, lapping and suitable burnishing; not every method corrects all error types equally.
  • Heat treatment can distort teeth; choose pre-/post-heat-treatment finishing according to hardness, stock and required geometry.
  • Grinding may restore geometry after hardening; lapping mainly refines contact/small deviations rather than fixing major spacing errors.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Generation પછી specified profile, pitch, lead, runout, surface/contact requirements માટે finishing.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Types shaving, grinding, honing, lapping, suitable burnishing;દરેક method બધી errors equally correct નહિ.
  • Heat treatment distortion આપી શકે; hardness, stock, geometry મુજબ pre/post finishing.
  • Grinding hardening પછી geometry restore કરી શકે; lapping contact/small deviations માટે, major spacing repair નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Serrated gear-like cutter removes fine chips by sliding contact with an already cut gear.

Classification / representative type

  • Shaving is fine cutting, not abrasive grinding; conventional, diagonal, plunge and other arrangements exist.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Hardened gear-shaped cutter carries fine serrations forming many cutting edges.
  2. Crossed-axis mounting creates useful sliding at tooth contact.
  3. Work arbor/support controls gear runout and orientation.
  4. Drive rotates the cutter/work pair in mesh.
  5. Feed/infeed arrangement controls contact and stock removal.
  6. Coolant/chip removal and inspection equipment support fine finishing.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Previously cut gear is provided with suitable shaving stock.
  2. Cutter and gear engage at the designed crossed-axis relation.
  3. Rotation generates sliding across contacting flanks.
  4. Serration edges remove very small chips from high spots and prescribed stock.
  5. Feed distributes contact along the required tooth region.
  6. Geometry and surface are measured; later heat treatment may change the achieved condition.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: crossed-axis angle, stock allowance, feed, tool condition, work hardness and rigidity.

Applications / advantages

Productive finishing of suitable relatively soft gears before hardening; improves surface/contact and modest errors.

Limitations / safety

Cannot remove major errors or automatically correct subsequent hardening distortion; achievable accuracy must be verified for the specified flank characteristics.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Serrated gear-like cutter already cut gearમાંથી sliding contactથી fine chips કાઢે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Shaving fine cutting છે, abrasive grinding નહિ; conventional, diagonal, plunge વગેરે.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Hardened gear-shaped cutter પર fine serrations હોય છે,જે અનેક નાની cutting edges બનાવે છે.
  2. Crossed-axis mountingથી tooth contact વખતે જરૂરી sliding motion મળે છે.
  3. Work arbor/support gearનું runout તથા orientation નિયંત્રિત રાખે છે.
  4. Drive meshમાં રહેલા cutter અને work pairને rotate કરે છે.
  5. Feed/infeed arrangement contact અને stock removalની માત્રા નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.
  6. Coolant/chip removal તથા inspection equipment fine finishingને આધાર આપે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. અગાઉ cut કરેલા gear પર suitable shaving stock રાખેલો હોય છે.
  2. Cutter અને gear designed crossed-axis relationship મુજબ engage થાય છે.
  3. Rotationથી contacting tooth flanksની વચ્ચે sliding ઉત્પન્ન થાય છે.
  4. Serration edges high spots તથા prescribed stockમાંથી ખૂબ નાના chips દૂર કરે છે.
  5. Feed toothના required regionમાં contact વહેંચે છે,જેથી finishing એક જગ્યાએ મર્યાદિત ન રહે.
  6. Geometry તથા surface measure થાય છે;પછીનું heat treatment achieved geometryને ફરી બદલી શકે છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Angle, stock, feed, tool condition, hardness, rigidity.

Applications / લાભ

Suitable relatively soft gearsનું pre-hardening productive finish; surface/contact, modest errors સુધારે.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Major errors/later distortion automatically repair નહિ; specified flank accuracy verify કરવી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Bonded abrasive removes controlled stock to finish gear flanks, often after hardening.

Classification / representative type

  • Form grinding uses a dressed tooth-space profile; generating grinding uses a rolling relation with rack/worm-like abrasive geometry.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Grinding spindle and wheel deliver abrasive cutting speed.
  2. Wheel form or generating geometry must match the selected tooth system.
  3. Workholding controls runout and datum alignment.
  4. Indexing/generating control coordinates work and wheel path.
  5. Dressing/truing establishes wheel geometry and cutting condition.
  6. Coolant delivery, filtration, thermal control and enclosure manage heat/debris.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Correct stock and hardened condition are confirmed.
  2. Wheel is trued/dressed to the required form or generating specification.
  3. Controlled approach brings abrasive grains into flank contact.
  4. Fine stock is removed by the prescribed indexed form or generating motion.
  5. Heat and wheel wear are controlled; excessive heat can burn/damage the surface.
  6. Measured profile, lead, pitch, runout and surface determine acceptance, not the word grinding alone.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: wheel specification, dressing, stock/pass, feed, speed, coolant and thermal stability.

Applications / advantages

High-accuracy hardened transmission/precision gears and correction of suitable heat-treatment deviations.

Limitations / safety

Higher cost and thermal-damage risk; quality depends on machine, dressing, datum, stock and measurement.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Bonded abrasive controlled stockથી gear flanks finish કરે,ઘણી વાર hardening પછી.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Form grinding dressed space profile; generating grinding rack/worm-like geometry સાથે rolling.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Grinding spindle અને wheel abrasive cutting માટે જરૂરી speed આપે છે.
  2. Wheelનું form અથવા generating geometry selected tooth systemને અનુરૂપ હોવું જોઈએ.
  3. Workholding gearનું runout અને datum alignment નિયંત્રિત રાખે છે.
  4. Indexing/generating control work તથા wheelના pathsને coordinate કરે છે.
  5. Dressing/truingથી wheelની geometry અને cutting condition સ્થાપિત થાય છે.
  6. Coolant delivery,filtration,thermal control તથા enclosure heat અને debris સંભાળે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Grinding પહેલાં correct stock અને required hardened condition confirm થાય છે.
  2. Wheelને required form અથવા generating specification મુજબ true/dress કરવામાં આવે છે.
  3. Controlled approach abrasive grainsને flankના contactમાં લાવે છે.
  4. Prescribed indexed-form અથવા generating motionથી fine stock દૂર થાય છે.
  5. Heat તથા wheel wear નિયંત્રિત થાય છે;વધુ heatથી surface burn અથવા damage થઈ શકે છે.
  6. Measured profile,lead,pitch,runout અને surfaceથી acceptance નક્કી થાય છે;ફક્ત grinding નામ પૂરતું નથી.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Wheel spec, dressing, stock/pass, feed, speed, coolant, thermal stability.

Applications / લાભ

High-accuracy hardened transmission/precision gears, suitable heat-treatment errors correction.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Higher cost, thermal risk; machine, dressing, datum, stock, measurement પર quality.

h.en: 2.7.3 Achievable accuracy: how to state it responsibly

body.en:
Definition / principle

Accuracy is a set of measured deviations under a specified standard and gear size—not a universal process tolerance.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Shaving provides small-stock correction and improved finish on suitable work before final hardening; grinding can provide finer control, including hardened flanks.
  • State profile, helix/lead, pitch and runout requirements separately; gear quality grade is not surface roughness Ra.
  • Example of an acceptance statement: if the drawing permits maximum profile deviation8micrometres, the measured deviation must meet that limit using the specified inspection method. Neither shaving nor grinding alone proves it.
  • Reported shaving example: a supplier describes grade6 under GB/T10095.1-2008 and Ra0.2–0.8micrometres. This is an attributed attainable example, not a guarantee for every shaving setup.[3]
  • Reported grinding example: a supplier lists cylindrical DIN classes6–4 and routine industrial work at class5or6, depending on the gear. This is capability reporting, not an independently verified universal limit.[1]
  • Grades from different standards/editions are not interchangeable without checking definitions and evaluated errors; always state the standard, gear specification and inspection result.
  • Do not quote one unsupported micron value or accuracy grade as guaranteed for every module, diameter, material and machine.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Accuracy specified standard, size હેઠળ measured deviations છે, universal process tolerance નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Shaving suitable work before final hardeningમાં small-stock correction, finish; grinding hardened flanksમાં પણ finer control.
  • Profile, helix/lead, pitch, runout અલગ requirements; quality grade એટલે Ra નહિ.
  • Example: drawing maximum profile deviation8micrometres આપે તો specified methodનું measured deviation limitમાં જોઈએ;ફક્ત shaving/grindingથી prove નહિ.
  • Reported shaving exampleમાં supplier GB/T10095.1-2008 હેઠળ grade6 અને Ra0.2–0.8micrometres જણાવે છે.આ attributed attainable example છે,દરેક setupની guarantee નહિ.[3]
  • Reported grinding exampleમાં supplier cylindrical DIN classes6–4,અને gear મુજબ routine industrial class5or6 જણાવે છે.આ reported capability છે, independently verified universal limit નહિ.[1]
  • જુદા standards/editionsના grades definitions/errors ચકાસ્યા વગર interchangeable નથી; standard, gear specification, inspection result લખો.
  • દરેક module, diameter, material, machine માટે એક unsupported micron/grade guarantee નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A thread is a helical ridge/groove used for fastening, motion or sealing according to its design.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • By location: external/internal; hand: right/left; starts: single/multiple; profile: V, square, trapezoidal, buttress and others.
  • Major, minor and pitch diameters describe crest/root/effective geometry; pitch diameter governs functional fit with other specified factors.
  • Pitch is axial spacing of corresponding adjacent forms; lead is axial advance per revolution. Lead=starts×pitch.
  • Included flank angle, crest, root and thread depth are profile terms; nominal diameter alone is not a full thread specification.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Thread helical ridge/groove છે; design મુજબ fastening, motion, sealing.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Location external/internal; hand right/left; starts single/multiple; profile V, square, trapezoidal, buttress વગેરે.
  • Major, minor, pitch diameters crest/root/effective geometry; pitch diameter અન્ય factors સાથે fit નક્કી કરે.
  • Pitch adjacent formsનું axial spacing; lead revolutionદીઠ advance; lead=starts×pitch.
  • Included angle, crest, root, depth profile terms;ફક્ત nominal diameter complete spec નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A profile tool and synchronised axial feed generate a helical groove by chip removal.

Classification / representative type

  • External/internal; right/left hand; single/multistart require the corresponding setup/tool access.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Lathe workholding supports rotating blank with controlled runout.
  2. Single-point tool has the specified included angle and root/crest-form allowance.
  3. Tool holder/boring bar supports correct centre height and rigidity.
  4. Lead screw/change gears or CNC synchronisation links spindle position and axial travel.
  5. Cross/compound or controlled infeed develops thread depth in passes.
  6. Relief/run-out space and gauging arrangement support safe exit and functional inspection.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Blank/bore and tool form are matched to thread specification.
  2. Synchronisation sets axial travel per revolution equal to required lead.
  3. Tool advances along the rotating work and removes a helical chip.
  4. Multiple controlled passes deepen the profile without exceeding suitable loads.
  5. For multiple starts, additional helices have controlled phase offsets while each uses the same lead.
  6. Gauge checks pitch diameter, lead, form and fit; theoretical sharp-V depth is not automatically finished thread depth.

Working parameters / controls

  • Parameters: lead, speed, infeed, tool profile, hand, run-out and synchronisation.

Applications / advantages

Flexible small batches, special threads and larger sizes.

Limitations / safety

Slower than dedicated high-volume methods; loss of sync or insufficient run-out can damage tool/work.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Profile tool, synchronised axial feedથી chip removal દ્વારા helical groove.

Classification / Representative Type

  • External/internal, right/left, single/multistart માટે corresponding setup/access.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Lathe workholding rotating blankને આધાર આપે છે અને runout નિયંત્રિત રાખે છે.
  2. Single-point toolમાં specified included angle તથા root/crest-form માટે જરૂરી allowance હોય છે.
  3. Tool holder/boring bar યોગ્ય centre height અને rigidity જાળવે છે.
  4. Lead screw/change gears અથવા CNC synchronisation spindle positionને axial travel સાથે જોડે છે.
  5. Cross/compound અથવા controlled infeed અનેક passesમાં thread depth વિકસાવે છે.
  6. Relief/run-out space તથા gauging arrangement safe exit અને functional inspectionને મદદ કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Thread specification મુજબ blank/bore તથા tool form match કરવામાં આવે છે.
  2. Synchronisationથી revolutionદીઠ axial travel required lead જેટલું સ્થાપિત થાય છે.
  3. Rotating workની સાથે tool axial દિશામાં આગળ વધે છે અને helical chip દૂર કરે છે.
  4. Suitable loadsની મર્યાદામાં controlled multiple passesથી profile વધુ ઊંડો બને છે.
  5. Multiple startsમાં વધારાની helices માટે controlled phase offsets હોય છે,પણ દરેક helixનો lead સમાન રહે છે.
  6. Gaugingથી pitch diameter,lead,form તથા fit તપાસાય છે;theoretical sharp-V depthને finished depth ન માનવી.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Lead, speed, infeed, profile, hand, run-out, sync.

Applications / લાભ

Flexible small batches, special threads, large sizes.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Dedicated methods કરતાં slow; sync loss/run-out shortage damage.

h.en: 2.9.2 Thread cutting by taps and dies

body.en:
Definition / principle

Tap cuts an internal thread; threading die cuts an external thread by multiple coordinated edges.

Classification / representative type

  • Taps: hand/machine, straight/spiral-flute or spiral-point as appropriate; dies: solid/split/adjustable arrangements. A forming tap is a separate chipless process.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Tap has threaded cutting lands, lead chamfer and flutes; not every flute style suits every hole.
  2. Die contains matching internal cutting profile with entry chamfer and chip spaces.
  3. Holder guides torque and alignment; machine holders may include suitable compensation/control.
  4. Prepared hole/blank size and entry chamfer support engagement.
  5. Workholding resists torque without misaligning the thread axis.
  6. Lubrication/chip-control and depth/run-out provision suit through or blind holes.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Prepared size is chosen from the actual thread/material/tool recommendation, not nominal diameter alone.
  2. Tap or die aligns with intended axis and engages its lead portion.
  3. Rotation and matched axial advance allow teeth to remove material progressively.
  4. Flutes/chip spaces carry chips according to tool design; blind-hole space is limited.
  5. Depth/length is controlled and the tool is withdrawn by the proper approved cycle.
  6. Functional gauges and inspection confirm fit and complete usable thread length.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: prepared size, alignment, tool type, lead chamfer, speed, lubrication, chip direction and usable depth.

Applications / advantages

Common internal/external standard threads with productive multi-edge cutting.

Limitations / safety

Tap breakage, chip packing and blind-hole bottoming are risks; no live manual intervention instructions are given.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Tap internal, threading die external thread multiple edgesથી cut કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Taps hand/machine, straight/spiral-flute/spiral-point; dies solid/split/adjustable; forming tap અલગ chipless process.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Tapમાં threaded cutting lands,lead chamfer અને flutes હોય છે;દરેક flute style દરેક hole માટે યોગ્ય નથી.
  2. Dieમાં matching internal cutting profile,entry chamfer અને chips માટે spaces હોય છે.
  3. Holder torque તથા alignment guide કરે છે;machine holdersમાં suitable compensation/control હોઈ શકે છે.
  4. Prepared hole/blank size અને entry chamferથી શરૂઆતનું engagement યોગ્ય થાય છે.
  5. Workholding thread axis ખસેડ્યા વગર cutting torque resist કરે છે.
  6. Lubrication/chip control અને depth/run-out space through અથવા blind holeની જરૂરિયાત મુજબ હોય છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Prepared size actual thread,material તથા tool recommendationથી પસંદ થાય છે;ફક્ત nominal diameter પરથી નહિ.
  2. Tap અથવા die intended axis સાથે align થઈ lead portionથી engage થાય છે.
  3. Rotation અને matching axial advanceથી teeth ક્રમશઃ material દૂર કરે છે.
  4. Flutes/chip spaces tool design મુજબ chips વહન કરે છે;blind holeમાં ઉપલબ્ધ જગ્યા ઓછી હોય છે.
  5. Depth/length નિયંત્રિત થાય છે અને proper approved cycleથી tool withdraw થાય છે.
  6. Functional gauges તથા inspectionથી fit અને સંપૂર્ણ usable thread length confirm થાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Prepared size, alignment, type, chamfer, speed, lubrication, chips, depth.

Applications / લાભ

Common standard internal/external threads, productive multi-edge cutting.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Tap breakage, chip packing, bottoming risks; live manual intervention નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Hardened dies plastically displace ductile blank material into a thread without cutting chips.

Classification / representative type

  • Flat-die reciprocating arrangement; one die is typically stationary and the other moves relatively.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Two hardened flat dies carry the thread impression at the appropriate helix orientation.
  2. Stationary die support provides a rigid reaction.
  3. Moving slide provides controlled relative travel.
  4. Blank feeding presents correct size and orientation to the entry region.
  5. Die separation/penetration control determines deformation and fill.
  6. Exit, collection and guarding protect the repeated rolling cycle.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Ductile blank reaches the dies with suitable starting diameter.
  2. Relative die motion grips and rotates the blank through friction/contact.
  3. Progressively deeper die impression compresses the surface.
  4. Material flows from valleys towards crests rather than leaving as chips.
  5. Blank rolls along the die length while the complete profile develops.
  6. Exit part is checked for fill, folds, diameter and lead/fit.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: blank diameter/material, die profile/pitch, penetration, feed/rolling speed, lubrication and machine stiffness.

Applications / advantages

Fast high-volume bolts/screws; good surface and favourable fibre flow when properly processed.

Limitations / safety

Needs ductile stock, suitable volume and expensive dies; hard/brittle materials or poor fill can fail.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Hardened dies ductile blankને plastically displace કરી chip વગર thread બનાવે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Flat-die reciprocating;સામાન્ય એક stationary,બીજી relative move.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. બે hardened flat dies પર appropriate helix orientationવાળા thread impressions હોય છે.
  2. Stationary die support rigid reaction આપે છે,જેથી blankની deformation માટે આધાર મળે.
  3. Moving slide controlled relative travel આપે છે,જે blankને roll કરાવે છે.
  4. Blank feeding યોગ્ય starting size તથા orientationવાળો blank entry regionમાં આપે છે.
  5. Die separation/penetration control deformation તથા profile fillની માત્રા નક્કી કરે છે.
  6. Exit,collection તથા guarding repeated rolling cycleને સુરક્ષિત રાખે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Suitable starting diameterવાળો ductile blank dies સુધી પહોંચે છે.
  2. Relative die motion friction/contactથી blankને grip કરીને rotate કરે છે.
  3. ક્રમશઃ વધુ ઊંડો die impression blankની surfaceને compress કરે છે.
  4. Material chips તરીકે દૂર થવાને બદલે valleysમાંથી crests તરફ flow થાય છે.
  5. Blank dieની length પર roll થાય છે અને ધીમે ધીમે complete thread profile બને છે.
  6. બહાર નીકળેલા partમાં fill,folds,diameter તથા lead/fitની તપાસ થાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Blank diameter/material, die profile/pitch, penetration, feed/speed, lubrication, stiffness.

Applications / લાભ

High-volume bolts/screws; proper processમાં good surface, fibre flow.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Ductile stock, volume, expensive dies જોઈએ; hard/brittle/poor fillથી failure.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Hardened dies plastically displace ductile blank material into a thread without cutting chips.

Classification / representative type

  • Two-/three-die cylindrical systems; infeed or through-feed according to die/machine geometry.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Hardened cylindrical dies carry matching thread profiles.
  2. Die spindles rotate with required phasing and support.
  3. Radial infeed or inclined through-feed arrangement controls engagement.
  4. Work support/centres or rest maintain axis and resist bending.
  5. Blank preparation controls material volume and initial diameter.
  6. Lubrication, guards and collection support repeated service.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Blank is supported between the intended rolls.
  2. Rotating dies contact and rotate it in the designed relationship.
  3. Controlled infeed raises contact pressure beyond plastic-flow conditions.
  4. Material displaces to fill the thread impression without chip removal.
  5. Infeed rolls complete the profile in place; through-feed arrangements also advance the work axially.
  6. Dies retract/release according to cycle and the thread is gauged.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: blank diameter/material, die profile/pitch, penetration, feed/rolling speed, lubrication and machine stiffness.

Applications / advantages

Longer or larger suitable rolled threads and controlled production.

Limitations / safety

Blank volume, ductility, die phasing and support are critical; rolling is not appropriate for every thread/material.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Hardened dies ductile blankને plastically displace કરી chip વગર thread બનાવે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Two/three cylindrical dies; geometry મુજબ infeed/through-feed.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Hardened cylindrical dies પર matching thread profiles હોય છે,જે blankમાં impression આપે છે.
  2. Die spindles required phasing સાથે rotate થાય છે અને diesને rigid support આપે છે.
  3. Radial infeed અથવા inclined through-feed arrangement engagement નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.
  4. Work support/centres અથવા rest axis જાળવે છે અને blankનું bending resist કરે છે.
  5. Blank preparation starting diameter તથા ઉપલબ્ધ material volume નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.
  6. Lubrication,guards તથા collection repeated service માટે જરૂરી support આપે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Blankને intended rolls વચ્ચે યોગ્ય આધાર સાથે મુકવામાં આવે છે.
  2. Rotating dies designed relationshipમાં blankને contact કરીને તેને rotate કરાવે છે.
  3. Controlled infeedથી contact pressure plastic flow માટે જરૂરી સ્થિતિથી ઉપર વધે છે.
  4. Material displacementથી thread impression ભરાય છે;chips દૂર કરીને profile બનતું નથી.
  5. Infeedમાં profile એક જગ્યાએ પૂર્ણ થાય છે;through-feed arrangementમાં work axial દિશામાં પણ આગળ વધે છે.
  6. Cycle મુજબ dies retract/release થાય છે અને બનેલા threadની gauging કરવામાં આવે છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Blank diameter/material, die profile/pitch, penetration, feed/speed, lubrication, stiffness.

Applications / લાભ

Suitable longer/larger rolled threads, controlled production.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Blank volume, ductility, phasing, support જરૂરી;દરેક thread/material માટે rolling નહિ.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Illustrative3-start thread, pitch2mm, spindle120rev/min.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Lead=starts×pitch=3×2=6mm/rev
